name: UnSub (Cambodia scam operation) — OpenAI
brief: OpenAI disrupted a Cambodia-based (Poipet border-town) scam network that used ChatGPT across its full "ping–zing–sting" fraud lifecycle: translating and generating scam conversations on WhatsApp/Telegram, researching and building fake dating/investment personas, drafting promotional content for fraudulent investment/crypto/spot-gold and fake-gambling schemes, and generating forged images of passports, legal notices, stock-purchase confirmations and gambling-platform interfaces. A subset of operators also used ChatGPT for internal administrative work — translating staff messages and documenting matters OpenAI says "appeared related to recruitment, immigration status, working conditions, and employee discipline," including social-media ads recruiting "chatter" jobs in Poipet and records of employee debts/disciplinary fines — consistent with forced-labor/human-trafficking indicators alongside the fraud operation. *Analyst note: victim-loss figures are drawn from the scammers' own chat logs, not independently verified by OpenAI ("we are unable to independently verify those claims"); no named actor/group designation is given.* OpenAI
ttpMd:
**LLM-supported social engineering** T1566 - Phishing (persona-based scam messaging, translation)

T1657 - Financial Theft
